chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!

key_terms.لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ: For the deniers, those who rejected the truth
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe or calamity, a cry of distress in Hell
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wail' for the deniers in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who deny the prophetic message, linking their denial directly to their spiritual ruin. It serves as a potent eschatological warning, emphasizing that the 'woe' is not merely a future threat but a consequence of their persistent rejection of truth during their earthly life.
